notes: כִּי takes the pair *For though* as one rendering and heads on *though*, since the morpheme the pair renders is itself a subordinator (rule 55's head directive); the waw before אֵין is `unrepresented`, the ASV writing no connective there.
The competing reading gives *he will not* whole to אֵין under rule 50; the participle was preferred as the morpheme carrying the clause's predication, leaving the existential only the negation word.
The margin's literal *answer* corroborates the identification of מַעֲנֶה without moving the unit (rule 38).
